summary: Tvardi Therapeutics filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for an at-the-market (ATM) common stock offering of up to $9.69 million via JonesTrading. No merger, tender, or special situation is involved. The filing updates a prior $12.5 million ATM under which ~$11 million was already sold. Priced at market; no premium, fixed price, or board recommendation. This is a routine shelf takedown, not a special situation.
